1.Name: Pronghorn Ribs
1.Description: Because these lizards are always found frolicking in the quagmire, their flesh is very firm with excellent texture and elasticity, making their meat the highest quality ingredient. Steaks taken from their ribs are the highest grade of meat. Can be acquired by hunting.

2.Name: Steelthorn Hen
2.Description: A breed of chicken reared in the steel spine cliffs. The meat is fatty and succulent, perfect for broiling whole. Can be acquired by hunting.

3.Name: Diced Golden Desert Boa
3.Description: The golden desert boa is constrictor found in the Scorched Expanse, and although not venomous, it has a terrible bite. The flesh is flavorful and chewy, and can be cooked in a multitude of ways. Can be acquired by hunting.

4.Name: Deep-sea Dotted Rainbow Fish
4.Description: A fish that resides in the deepest parts of the ocean, it has a delicate temperament and firm flesh. The roe of this fish tastes similar to salmon roe, possessing a briny taste. Can be acquired by hunting.

5.Name: Starry Night Blue Lobster
5.Description: Myth says that this lobster can only be caught in the clear, blue ocean under the star-lit sky. The truth is, the name draws from the spots upon its dark blue carapace. Can be acquired by hunting.

6.Name: Short-tail Veal Steak
6.Description: The short-tailed calf is a herbivore with a robust constitution that is reared in Dura's Gift. Its meat is supple, nutritious, tasty, and can be cooked in a multitude of ways, making it a popular meat among the Maulers. Can be acquired by hunting.

7.Name: Bok-choy
7.Description: A common vegetable in Esperia. It's a leafy green with white stems possessing a crunchy texture and refreshing flavor, it's a good accompaniment to most dishes. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

8.Name: Succulent Dewdrop
8.Description: A vined plant that possesses a fragrant, mouth-watering aroma, it has a multitude of uses as an ingredient. When dried out, its fragrance is enhanced and acquires a richer, distinctive quality. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

9.Name: Oasis Eggplant
9.Description: When plucked from the swamp, the Oasis Eggplant immediately makes a jarring noise similar to the screams of a baby. The sound fades away after being out of the mud for a short time. It has a sweet, tangy flavor and is rich in nutrients. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

10.Name: Ruby Oxalis
10.Description: Fruits of this herbal plant are ruby-colored and look like drops of water. They have a chewy texture and a mildly sour taste, it is an oft-used ingredient in mixology. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

11.Name: Twin Persimmons
11.Description: Wilders cultivated edible fruits and vegetables into one plant that produces two different persimmon varieties; one red and one yellow. The red possesses a robust sweet flavor and the yellow possesses a slightly sour flavor. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

12.Name: Golden Apple
12.Description: A fruit that grows in Dura's Gift, it is juicy with a crisp bite and a sweet flavor. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

13.Name: Dragonberry
13.Description: Suitable to be eaten raw or pressed into juice, it is a sweet fruit. Besides being grown for harvest, the Noble Tavern often makes use of the Dragonberry husks during their Feast of the Beasts prize giveaways. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

14.Name: Golden Tumble Berry
14.Description: Unripe, this pink fruit is bitter with a crisp bite. Once ripened, the skin turns a warm yellow color, whereupon it will tumble from the branches of the tree in which it grows. Left on the floor, it will lose all flavor and become unpalatable and inedible. Can be acquired by sowing seeds.

15.Name: Bok-choy Seeds
15.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Bok-choys. Can be acquired by hunting.

16.Name: Succulent Dewdrop Seeds
16.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Succulent Dewdrops. Can be acquired by hunting.

17.Name: Oasis Eggplant Seeds
17.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Oasis Eggplants. Can be acquired by hunting.

18.Name: Ruby Oxalis Seeds
18.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Ruby Oxalis. Can be acquired by hunting.

19.Name: Twin Persimmon Seeds
19.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Twin Persimmons. Can be acquired by hunting.

20.Name: Golden Apple Seeds
20.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Golden Apples. Can be acquired by hunting.

21.Name: Dragonberry Seeds
21.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Dragonberries. Can be acquired by hunting.

22.Name: Golden Tumble Berry Seeds
22.Description: Planting these seeds will produce Golden Tumble Berries. Can be acquired by hunting.
